Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) time Qual Ptr quality of HW time stamp, e.g. based on current drift time Stamp Ptr current time stamp Return value Std _ Return Type E_ OK: successful E_ NOT_ OK: failed Description Returns a time value out of the HW registers according to the capability of the HW. Is the HW resolution is lower than the Eth_ Time Stamp Type resolution resp. range, than an the remaining bits will be filled with 0. Important Note: Eth_ Get Current Time may be called within an exclusive area. Available via Eth.h
